programmes.d: Dad goes back to school in Timmy's fifth grade; Timmy steals Jorgen's grandmother's secret recipe for brownies.
Timmy discovers a plot to destroy the Crimson Chin's reputation; Timmy wishes for access to Vicky's diary.
Timmy wishes that his parents had some new friends; Timmy wishes that he and Trixie were the only two people on Earth.
Sparky is forbidden from dating Dinkleberg's new dog; Timmy wishes all women away to end Mom's constant nagging.
Timmy convinces the fairies, anti-fairies and pixies to participate in a competition to see who is best.
Vicky advertises on the radio; Mark Chang seeks Timmy's help in defeating an alien race.
Timmy wishes that everything he says is right; Timmy gets to be placed with the big kids.

Mr. Crocker creates Wonky Cosmo and Wanda clones to get into a Fairy Convention to steal all the fairies' magic; Timmy wishes Chloe could live out her favorite dystopian movie but quickly regrets it when everyone is hungry.
Timmy wishes that his mother were a better cook; the Turners win a trip to space.
Timmy helps Jorgen find a new job after he is fired; Sparky makes his own magic dog treats.
Timmy must find a replacement for his father in the Father-Son Squirrelly Scout competition; Vicky baby-sits Timmy at her house.
A magical bug containing her evil essence crawls out of Vicky, leaving a sweet and docile teenager; boring creatures called Pixies who treat magic like a business buy Fairy World.
Timmy wishes for Vicky to find the perfect boyfriend; Timmy wishes that he were the funniest person on Earth.
Cosmo is chosen to be the host of the secret fairy convention; Timmy sends Wanda to a spa for a day off.
After Timmy wishes for a talking car, he goes on an adventure in Fairy World with Wanda, Poof and "Carsmo"; Timmy convinces Cosmo and Wanda to give him his own magic wand with 10 wishes on it.
Timmy and Chloe wish that their families go camping together, but there is a feud between their parents. Chloe wishes to be a mother so she can go to Dimmsdale Daze Carnival with Timmy.
Timmy borrows Mark Chang's Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie's costume party; Cosmo must enforce the rules when Jorgen comes down with the Trick-ups.
Mark Chang seeks Timmy's help in hiding from his fiancé; Timmy must undergo a program that will teach him to make responsible wishes.
Crocker pretends to be future Timmy using stolen DNA; Timmy and the others chip in to help Cosmo find his lost wand.
Timmy wishes his father had a cooler job; Timmy enters the Dimm-a-dance Film Festival to impress Trixie Tang.
Timmy wishes for a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy and half-something else; when Timmy wishes for a simpler world, everyone is transported to prehistoric times.
Timmy wishes for 12 hours of pure darkness; the Turners are stranded on a deserted island.
Cosmo and Wanda receive invitations to their high-school reunion; Timmy wishes he were the strongest guy on the beach.
Timmy wishes that the whole world could be like his Crimson Chin comic book.
Timmy and Chloe help the depressed Catman prove to his girlfriend that he is a real superhero; Mr. Crocker teaches his nephew Kevin Crocker how to become a Fairy Hunter.
Timmy gets caught in the middle of a feud between Chester and A.J.; Timmy's mother starts predicting the weather.
After deciding she wants to be an actress, Vicky forces Timmy to help her get her first role; Dad flushes Timmy and the fairies down the toilet.
Timmy's father turns their home into a farm; Mr. Crocker tries to expose monsters on a web show.
Timmy tries to help the star of a superhero television show; Timmy accidentally releases a genie from a magic lava lamp.

The Squirrely Scouts go into space to plant a flag on unfamiliar terrain, hoping to achieve a special Squirrely Scout status; Chloe spends the summer vacation studying, but her inner child disagrees and causes her to make crazy wishes in her sleep.
Patrick wakes up off-model; the Star family works at the Krusty Krab.
Patrick spawns a mini-Patrick who becomes the star of the show, until he outgrows the role; the Star family celebrates the Klopnodian holiday Swaptoberfest by swapping identities with each other.
Squidina hires an assistant who's a little too good at his job; the Patrick Star Show is interrupted by a most peculiar stench.
Bunny tries to punish Patrick for chocolate-favored crimes; the Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next.
SpongeBob and Patrick paint Mr. Krabs's living room; Krusty Krab training video.
The Flying Dutchman takes up residence at SpongeBob's house; the beneficiaries of Sandy's treedome pay her a visit.
SpongeBob visits the dreams of others; SpongeBob comes down with the sniffles.
SpongeBob suspects Patrick of stealing his jellyfishing net; SpongeBob builds a ventriloquist dummy modeled after Squidward.
SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward buy Mr. Krabs a new mattress; Plankton sues Mr. Krabs after falling at the Krusty Krab.

SpongeBob hides from Sandy; SpongeBob and Patrick borrow a balloon from a store and accidentally pop it.
SpongeBob brings herds of jellyfish to Mr. Krabs; Patrick gets a job at the Chum Bucket and competes with SpongeBob in the Fry Cook Games.
SpongeBob takes his turn as hall monitor; SpongeBob brings home a wild jellyfish.
Mr. Krabs sells his restaurant and goes into early retirement; Squidward convinces SpongeBob that he has a laugh-related illness.
SpongeBob micromanages an all-out shindig for the denizens of Bikini Bottom.
Mr. Krabs wants to throw a birthday party for Pearl; SpongeBob receives an invitation to take part in a competition.
SpongeBob tries to make a special Valentine for his best friend Patrick; SpongeBob has some fun with a piece of paper Squidward threw away.
Gary runs away from home when SpongeBob forgets to feed him.
SpongeBob and Patrick sneak into the Treedome; Gary follows Patrick around, and SpongeBob becomes jealous.

After Walt's failed attempt at romance, Charles, Cliff and Geo try to find their pal a love connection; Lincoln and Clyde beg their parents to let them go to space cadets camp, but it's not as fun as they expected.

Ronnie Anne makes friends with Sid, a girl whose family wants to rent the apartment upstairs; when it looks like another couple might get it first, the girls resort to sabotage to try and dissuade them.

The sisters enlist Lincoln, the "Master of Convincing," to teach them how to ask their parents for money; when Lisa's report card reveals that she has failed social skills, she must make a friend in order to bring up her grade.
Lincoln and Clyde worry that they may be too old to still be playing Ace Savvy; Lincoln discovers that having a friend over means getting special privileges, and he takes advantage of that.

Lucy faces off against her friend Haiku to become the new president of the Young Morticians' Club at school; Leni is promoted to temporary manager at work, but worries about remaining good friends with Miguel and Fiona.

Zach and Rusty fake an alien landing, which sends the whole town on a hunt for little green men; Clyde thinks he's guaranteed the Glee Club solo, until Lincoln accidentally auditions and lands the part.

When the Loud parents win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the children with them because the children have promised to behave; when Lucy gets a crush on a "regular and normal" boy, her sisters decide to give her a makeover.

Lincoln and Clyde submit an Ace Savvy comic to a meet-the-creator contest, but are foiled by a surprising nemesis; when Lana brings home a new pet, whom the children adore, the four original Loud pets scheme to get rid of him.
